title: Choose the visual world for Prompt to Production
question: The roll picked Engineering Drawing Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Engineering Drawing Sheet
options.lineage: B.Tech Engineering Graphics sheets: A2 drafting paper, border, title block, dimension lines
options.thesis: The workshop drawn as an engineering drawing: a prompt goes in, a dimensioned product comes out.
materials: drafting paper with a fine grid
options.viewport: A full-width drawing sheet with a ruled border and zone letters. 'PROMPT → PRODUCTION' is set as the drawing's subject. A title block in the lower right holds the date, time, venue, fee and seats with a REGISTER stamp, and the official poster is pinned into the sheet as a detail view.
options.risk: If the line work is timid it reads as a blueprint pastiche; it has to be drawn with real drafting discipline (line weights, zones, sheet numbers).

raised.raise: Two inks only, Paytm navy and Paytm sky, carry every rule, box, type and speaker photo (duotoned); no third decorative colour.
State is shown with standard drawing line types, not colour alone: solid thick = confirmed/live, dashed hidden-line = pending, chain line = in review, struck = cancelled.
Every page carries its fast version: the title block is the one-glance summary (who, when, where, status) before the detail.

options.label: Paytm QR Standee
options.lineage: the blue Paytm QR stand at every shop counter in India
options.thesis: The event as a Paytm counter: scan, pay, you're in; the ticket and gate check-in are the hero.
options.viewport: A giant standee-shaped hero in Paytm sky with the event QR and seats-left counter, and a receipt strip listing date, venue and fee.
options.risk: Closest to what Paytm's own marketing already looks like; it can read as a Paytm ad rather than an NBKRIST event.

options.label: Seven-Segment Scoreboard
options.lineage: LED clocks, scoreboards and price totems
options.thesis: The event as a live scoreboard: countdown, seats left, check-ins and the leaderboard in LED segments.
options.viewport: A black panel with a huge segment countdown to 9:00 AM and a seats-left counter; event facts on smaller segment rows.
options.case: Strong for the countdown, check-in and leaderboard, weaker for speaker/institution identity and long forms.
options.risk: Reads as a gimmick on the registration and admin forms.

options.label: Mondo 2000 Duotone Spread
options.thesis: Two fluorescent inks for everything, angled headline slabs.
options.viewport: Angled headline slab across a duotone speaker photo.
options.case: Students and faculty don't identify with it, and the angled slabs hurt event-fact clarity.
options.kept: The two-ink discipline across every element.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: Everything hangs off one rail; state is line form, not hue.
options.viewport: One off-centre rail with event sections as ticks.
options.case: Too abstract for a campus event; the facts get lost.
options.kept: State carried by line form (solid, dashed, struck).

options.label: Wildstyle Blackbook
options.thesis: Interlocked letters with a fast throw-up version.
options.viewport: A wildstyle 'P2P' piece with a clean throw-up beside it.
options.case: Wrong register for an official institute + Paytm event.
options.kept: Every page gets a fast one-glance version.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean university/tech event site, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Poster and event facts side by side, a clear Register button, then speakers and schedule.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other college event page.
